active.name: MRP1
active.description: ABCC1, a multidrug-resistance efflux transporter. Blocking it is intended to restore the activity of chemotherapy agents the transporter pumps out of tumour cells.

targets.name: EGFR
targets.description: The kinase domain of the epidermal growth factor receptor. Inhibiting it blocks the growth signalling that drives several cancers.
